incident.affected: Keplr wallets created with Google/Apple login. Community analysis: most victims imported their seed phrases into Keplr; wallets created in the browser extension and backed up as a file were most likely hit. Evmos was also drained Nov 6.
incident.attacker: UNKNOWN — no attacker has been publicly named and no verified attacker wallet addresses have been published yet. Whoever controls the stolen funds has not cashed out anything so far.
incident.cause: Web3Auth security issue. Official line: key-share reconstruction path (unconfirmed). Community on-chain analysis (HooTang Clan, Nov 7): Web3Auth published MPC key shares and seed phrases in public GitHub repos (recorded May 22, 2025); the attacker collected them and waited. Affected wallets were mostly created in 2024 or earlier.

links.label: HooTang Clan — Cosmos wallet drain: what happened and how to stay safe (totals, 10 attacker wallets, timeline)

incident.safe: Wallets created with a recovery (seed) phrase or a hardware wallet (Ledger / Trezor) are NOT affected, per Keplr's initial assessment. MetaMask users are not affected. Do not export keys or move a social-login account into another wallet (Leap, Cosmostation, MetaMask) until Web3Auth publishes a post-mortem — the key-reconstruction path itself may be exposed.

timeline.event: Web3Auth pauses its embedded-wallet service after a security issue affecting third parties.
Keplr flags unauthorized transactions on some Google/Apple-login accounts.
Keplr posts its notice: social (Google/Apple) login paused; users told not to add funds or re-import those accounts.
Keplr co-founder Josh Lee: incident originated at Web3Auth; ~20% of social-login accounts affected, only a fraction drained; remaining accounts may be recoverable.
No confirmed loss total or drained-wallet count has been published by Keplr or Web3Auth. Earlier circulating figures were wrong and are not used here.

totals.walletsNote: Per-chain: Cosmos Hub 18,600+; Osmosis 29,100+; Injective 7,596. Per-chain counts sum higher than 41,500+ because one seed phrase appears on multiple chains.
totals.cashedOutNote: None of it has moved yet, per HooTang Clan. Circle can freeze ~$188K of Noble USDC in the Osmosis drain wallet.
